description: Crates the pinned toolchain can't fetch at their newest release, and the release Mynt resolves instead when a program's source commits no Cargo.lock. The SBF platform tools' own Cargo (1.84 with Anchor 0.32.1) can't read a manifest that needs edition 2024, and the MSRV-aware resolver (incompatible-rust-versions = fallback, with each program's rust-version) can't avoid one that a compatible crate requires outright. Each pin moves any locked version from `from` up to (not including) `below` to `precise`. src/solana/toolchain.ts reads it; a committed Cargo.lock is never changed. Remove a pin when the toolchain moves to a Cargo that reads the newer release.

pins.why: ahash 0.8.13 (rust-version 1.60) requires getrandom 0.4 for wasm32, and getrandom 0.4 is edition 2024 (rust-version 1.85); a Cargo.lock lists every target's crates, so the platform tools' Cargo 1.84 fails to parse it. 0.8.12 needs only getrandom 0.3 (rust-version 1.63).
